selected_evidence.requirement: Remove inventory temporary files after seven days
selected_evidence.summary: The original expired file was removed while the current file remained. Controlled testing removed an eight-day-old file and preserved a six-day-old file; the installed policy uses a seven-day modification-age threshold.
The persistent OnCalendar=daily timer is enabled, active, waiting, and scheduled for the next midnight, including after reboot.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 54089086-53d1-408b-a22f-57b1dea70e03, acknowledged the safe reboot, observed changed boot ID 72598dee-9d0f-4cd9-afd1-131283f54c14, and verified the system, timer, cleanup function, and retained current.tmp checksum recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 022
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-temp-cleanup <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
inventory_dir=/var/tmp/inventory
[ -d "$inventory_dir" ] || exit 0
exec /usr/bin/find "$inventory_dir" -xdev -type f -mmin +10079 -delete
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-temp-cleanup
chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/inventory-temp-cleanup
restorecon /usr/local/sbin/inventory-temp-cleanup 2>/dev/null || true
stat -c 'path=%n mode=%a owner=%U:%G selinux=%C' /usr/local/sbin/inventory-temp-cleanup
/usr/bin/sh -n /usr/local/sbin/inventory-temp-cleanup

set -eu
umask 022
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Remove inventory temporary files after seven days

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-temp-cleanup
User=root
Group=root
ANTRIEB_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.timer <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Run inventory temporary-file cleanup daily

[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=1m
Unit=inventory-temp-cleanup.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.timer
chown root:root /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.timer
restorecon /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.timer 2>/dev/null || true
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-temp-cleanup.timer

set -eu
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-temp-cleanup.timer
systemctl is-enabled inventory-temp-cleanup.timer
systemctl is-active inventory-temp-cleanup.timer
systemctl show inventory-temp-cleanup.timer -p UnitFileState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p NextElapseUSecRealtime -p LastTriggerUSec

commands.command:
set -eu
old_probe=/var/tmp/inventory/.cleanup-age-probe-old
young_probe=/var/tmp/inventory/.cleanup-age-probe-young
: > "$old_probe"
: > "$young_probe"
touch -d '8 days ago' "$old_probe"
touch -d '6 days ago' "$young_probe"
printf '%s\n' '--- controlled ages before service ---'
stat -c '%n mtime=%y' "$old_probe" "$young_probe"
systemctl start inventory-temp-cleanup.service
printf '%s\n' '--- controlled age assertions after service ---'
if [ -e "$old_probe" ]; then printf 'eight_day_file=UNEXPECTEDLY_PRESENT\n'; exit 1; else printf 'eight_day_file=removed\n'; fi
if [ -f "$young_probe" ]; then printf 'six_day_file=preserved\n'; else printf 'six_day_file=MISSING\n'; exit 1; fi
rm -f "$young_probe"
printf 'probe_cleanup='; if [ ! -e "$young_probe" ]; then printf 'complete\n'; else printf 'failed\n'; exit 1; fi
systemctl show inventory-temp-cleanup.service -p Result -p ExecMainStatus
